title: DeciCAD: Harness-Grounded Learning of Action Policies for CAD Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model agents operate through closed-loop action policies whose decision space is defined by an agent harness. We investigate how this operating space shapes agent behavior and policy learning in computer-aided design (CAD), a professional domain characterized by persistent state, geometric constraints, and long-horizon procedures. We instantiate this perspective in DeciCAD, a domain-native harness that exposes semantic CAD actions, decision-oriented observations, environment feedback, and persistent state transitions. Building on this harness, we develop a learning pipeline that extracts causal decision supervision from interaction trajectories and improves the policy through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and geometry-grounded online reinforcement learning (RL). translated_title: DeciCAD：面向CAD智能体的基于执行框架的动作策略学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过闭环动作策略运行，其决策空间由智能体执行框架所定义。我们研究了这一运行空间如何塑造计算机辅助设计（CAD）领域中的智能体行为与策略学习——CAD是一个以持久状态、几何约束和长时程流程为特征的专业领域。我们将这一视角具体化为DeciCAD，一个领域原生的执行框架，它提供语义化的CAD动作、面向决策的观测、环境反馈以及持久的状态转移。基于该框架，我们构建了一套学习流水线，从交互轨迹中提取因果决策监督信号，并通过监督微调（SFT）和基于几何的在线强化学习（RL）来改进策略。在四个CAD基准测试中，DeciCAD取得了最优的F1分数和交并比（IoU），同时相比通用框架将模型输出的token数量减少了45%至88%。
tldr: DeciCAD提出了一个面向CAD的领域原生智能体执行框架，通过从交互轨迹中提取因果决策监督，并结合监督微调与几何在线强化学习训练动作策略，在四个CAD基准上取得最优的F1与IoU，同时将模型输出token减少45%至88%。
en_tdlr: DeciCAD introduces a domain-native harness for CAD agents that extracts causal decision supervision from interaction trajectories and trains action policies via SFT and geometry-grounded online RL, achieving the best F1 and IoU across four CAD benchmarks while reducing output tokens by 45–88%.
